dimensions.evidenceA: The locked-room scene occurs before Jesus’ ascension.
dimensions.evidenceB: Pentecost follows the ascension and the period of waiting.
dimensions.label: Narrated time

dimensions.evidenceA: Breath, sending, and forgiveness accompany Jesus’ saying.
dimensions.evidenceB: Sound, fire-like tongues, filling, and languages accompany the event.
dimensions.label: Accompanying action

evidence.observation: The risen Jesus breathes on the gathered disciples and says, “Receive the Holy Spirit.”
On Pentecost the gathered group is filled with the Holy Spirit and begins speaking other languages.

record.tension: John places “Receive the Holy Spirit” before the ascension, while Acts narrates Spirit filling after the ascension on Pentecost.
record.title: When do the disciples receive the Holy Spirit?
